one_liner: Nifty 50 falls 0.86% amid IT sector weakness and global market declines.

drivers.title: Global Market Declines
drivers.detail: US and European markets fell significantly.

drivers.title: FII Outflows
drivers.detail: FIIs net sellers in cash market, Rs 582.99 Cr outflow.

flows_line: FIIs sold Rs 582.99 Cr; DIIs bought Rs 1,509.04 Cr.
watch_next: Watch for President Trump's speech and ECB announcements tomorrow.
lesson_seeds: IT sector news can heavily impact market sentiment.
Global market trends influence local indices.
Commodity price movements affect sectoral performance.
Institutional flows can signal market direction.
